name: LOSPOR Pediatric Rules — evidence draft
description: Inactive, source-backed pediatric platform draft. Drug runtime profiles are emitted only when the current route-only model can preserve the reviewed constraints. Fluid profiles preserve the canonical bag surface and add the reviewed pediatric Rate behavior; the full catalog remains editable through ruleset hierarchy.
blockers: 181 pediatric drug policies still require clinical governance approval
Weight-banded drug selection, cumulative/repeat limits, monitoring gates and preparation matrices remain schema exceptions

Indication, procedure/site, expected pathogens, local resistance, cultures or colonisation, allergy, age or gestation, renal function, infusion timing, redosing and therapeutic drug monitoring may change the regimen. Platform scope therefore provides no antimicrobial autofill or quick-dose pills; an institution may add only an AMS/ID/pharmacy-approved local protocol with provenance and a review date.
